laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'het self 'n hospitaal' is unidiomatic for 'has its own hospital'; 'n eie' is the natural form and matches the lesson's own 'eie kraan'; net word change 0.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'Haar dorp het self 'n hospitaal' is natural Afrikaans (compare 'Ek het self 'n motor') and its emphatic 'self' carries the contrast with Thabo's distant hospital; the proposal is a lateral move.
